"""Raw stdin/stdout envelope behaviour through the real entry point."""
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from tmp.run_check import execute

GOOD={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[],'services':[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}],
      'queries':[10],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],
      'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':1}],
      'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':1}]}
BAD_CAPTURE={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[],'services':[],'queries':[10],
             'captures':[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['!!!']}],'requests':[],'offers':[],
             'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}

def run(raw):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmp=Path(tmp); root=tmp/'root'; root.mkdir()
        (root/'deps').symlink_to(Path('/workspace/deps'),target_is_directory=True)
        sub=root/'submission'
        subprocess.run(['cp','-r','/workspace/submission',str(sub)],check=True)
        work=tmp/'w'; work.mkdir()
        out,err,code=execute(sub/'campaign.py',raw,work)
        return code,out,err

fails=[]
def check(label,raw,want):
    code,out,err=run(raw)
    if code:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'exit',code,err.decode()[:400]); return
    try:
        got=json.loads(out)
    except Exception as exc:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,'unparsable',out[:200],exc); return
    if got!=want:
        fails.append(label); print('FAIL',label,got,'want',want)

text=json.dumps(GOOD)
check('valid',text.encode(),{'manifest':[],'rejected':[],'snapshots':[
    {'at':10,'ledger':{'live':0,'deleted':0,'conflict':0},'unbound_applications':0,'leases':[]}],
    'active_requests':[],'plan':{'resolved':0,'cost':0,'assignments':[]}})
check('whitespace',b'  \n\t'+text.encode()+b'\n\n ',
      json.loads(text))
check('bom',b'\xef\xbb\xbf'+text.encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('duplicate root key',(text[:-1]+',"seed":"x"}').encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('duplicate nested key',json.dumps(dict(GOOD,leases=[
    {'id':'a','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1,
     'low_count':1}])).encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('nan',text.replace('"queries":[10]','"queries":[NaN]').encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('infinity',text.replace('"queries":[10]','"queries":[Infinity]').encode(),
      {'error':'invalid'})
check('float overflow',text.replace('"queries":[10]','"queries":[1e999]').encode(),
      {'error':'invalid'})
check('float',text.replace('"queries":[10]','"queries":[1.5]').encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('bool time',text.replace('"queries":[10]','"queries":[true]').encode(),
      {'error':'invalid'})
check('trailing data',(text+'{}').encode(),{'error':'invalid'})
check('array root',b'[1,2]',{'error':'invalid'})
check('string root',b'"x"',{'error':'invalid'})
check('number root',b'3',{'error':'invalid'})
check('empty input',b'',{'error':'invalid'})
check('invalid utf8',b'{"version":3,"\xff":1}',{'error':'invalid'})
check('broken json',b'{"version":3,',{'error':'invalid'})
check('bad capture',json.dumps(BAD_CAPTURE).encode(),{'error':'capture'})
check('metadata precedence',json.dumps(dict(BAD_CAPTURE,version=2)).encode(),
      {'error':'invalid'})
# deep nesting must not crash the process
deep=b'{"version":3,"seed":"s","leases":[],"services":[],"queries":[10],"captures":[],"requests":[],"offers":[],"request_quotas":'+b'['*4000+b']'*4000+b',"offer_quotas":[]}'
code,out,err=run(deep)
if code==0 and json.loads(out)!={'error':'invalid'}:
    fails.append('deep nesting'); print('FAIL deep nesting',out[:200])
elif code!=0:
    fails.append('deep nesting exit'); print('FAIL deep nesting exit',code,err[:300])
print('json tests done, failures:',len(fails))
PYEOF
